test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed part given in the sentence below.**

He has been used as the (**fall guy**) for issues with housing and unemployment.
solution:
The correct answer is **"scapegoat."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"fall guy"** means a person who is blamed or punished for the mistakes or wrongdoings of others. (वह व्यक्ति जिसे दूसरों की गलतियों या गलत कार्यों के लिए दोषी ठहराया या दंडित किया जाता है)

 
 
• **Example:** *He contends that he is innocent, that he was set up as a **fall guy**__.*
 
 
 
• The word **"scapegoat"** also means a person who is unfairly blamed or punished for something they did not do. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसे किसी ऐसी चीज़ के लिए गलत तरीके से दोषी ठहराया या दंडित किया जाता है जो उसने नहीं की, बलि का बकरा (दूसरों की ग़लती के लिए दंडित व्‍यकि्त))
 __
 
• **Example:** *When Akansha was sacked she felt she had been made a **scapegoat**__ for all the company’s problems.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, **"scapegoat"** is the word from the options that are similar in meaning to **"fall guy".**
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **"Reticent" **means quiet or reserved, and is not related to the meaning of the sentence. ((किसी विषय में) लोगों से बातें करने को अनिच्‍छुक; अल्‍पभाषी)
 
• **"Confiscate"** means to seize or take away property, and is not related to the meaning of the sentence. (दंडस्‍वरूप कोई वस्‍तु ज़ब्‍त कर लेना)
 
• **"Weakling" **means a person who is weak or lacks strength, and is not related to the meaning of the sentence. ((व्यक्ति या पशु) शारीरिक रूप से कमज़ोर; दुर्बल आदमी या पशु)
